title: Reproduction package: Assurance of Agent-Mediated Computational-Engineering Claims
description: Data, code and computational records for the article 'Assurance of Agent-Mediated Computational-Engineering Claims: A Critical Review of Specification, Authorization, Verification, Validation, and Evidence Binding' (Archives of Computational Methods in Engineering, submitted). Reproduces the literature-review, recall-audit and claim-level-audit results, verifies the preregistration and the hash-chained authorization log of the NACA 0012 case, replays its frozen analysis, and regenerates all figures.
